cases.title: Syntax::num(-1.0e-5)
cases.notes: Rounds to -0.0000, which trims to "-0" and is written as "0".

cases.title: Syntax::num(1.0e+20)
cases.notes: No exponent form, ever: PDF numbers have none.

cases.title: Syntax::num(0.03125)
cases.notes: A dyadic tie: the value is EXACTLY halfway at the fifth decimal, so %.4F decides the direction. PHP rounds these with its own formatter, not the C library; JavaScript toFixed and Python format() each have their own rule.

cases.title: Syntax::num(6.25e-5)
cases.notes: NOT a tie: 1/160000 is not dyadic, so the nearest double is a little off half.

cases.title: Syntax::num(1.00005)
cases.notes: Not a tie either: 1.00005 has no exact double; the nearest one decides.

cases.title: Syntax::rgb for every channel value 00-FF
cases.notes: All 256 channel values in one row, both directions: the full table a port needs for round(x / 255, 4).
